cap: Care is ethical when consent is valid and confidentiality is kept. A minor can usually consent alone to contraception, infection care and prenatal care. Valid consent needs capacity, disclosure of the reasonable alternatives and a voluntary choice, and capacity is a clinical judgment while competence is a legal status decided by a court. Tuskegee and coerced sterilization explain mistrust, so a capable patient's refusal is accepted and follow-up is offered.
